candidates.tagline: Built a billion-dollar closed stadium. Forgot grass needs sunlight.
candidates.story: For the 2026 FIFA World Cup, AT&T Stadium hung 18 massive LED rigs from its ceiling and bathed the entire interior in magenta-pink light for months — because the retractable roof that makes the arena weather-proof also blocks the sunlight FIFA requires natural grass to have.
candidates.why_funny: A $1.2 billion NFL stadium needed a full-scale indoor farm installation because the architects never considered that football grass and World Cup grass have one thing in common: they both need the sun.
candidates.alt: Interior of AT&T Stadium in Arlington Texas glowing bright magenta-pink from rows of LED grow lights on suspended trusses above the soccer field, with the stands and giant video screens visible in the pink-lit darkness

candidates.tagline: Amazon's 'humans pretending to be AI' platform loses to actual AI after 21 years
candidates.story: Amazon is shutting Mechanical Turk to new customers by July 30, 2026 — the platform named after an 18th-century chess 'automaton' that hid a human grandmaster in its cabinet built its whole business on paying people to do tasks AI couldn't handle, until AI could handle all of them.
candidates.why_funny: Amazon created 'Artificial Artificial Intelligence' — a machine that was secretly a person — only for real artificial intelligence to make both the machine and the person inside completely redundant.
candidates.alt: The original 18th-century Mechanical Turk chess-playing automaton on display: a wooden mannequin in a turban seated at a large cabinet chessboard, with the hinged compartments open below showing where a human chess master would hide during performances
